name: Neutrino & Dark Matter Group
fullName: Neutrino and Dark Matter Group at CUHK-Shenzhen
institution: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen
description: The Neutrino & Dark Matter Group at CUHK-Shenzhen studies dark matter, neutrinos and rare-event physics with noble-liquid detectors, including the XENONnT and RELICS experiments.
address: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen
